text:
Changed internal/datacoord/snapshot_manager.go and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/milvus-handoff-pin-cleanup.md.

Commit message:
On the Ostrava deployment (etcd across three zones ~40 ms apart) releasing a large snapshot's pins takes 6-9 s, so a 5 s timeout leaked the pins until restart.

writes.docs/decisions/milvus-handoff-pin-cleanu:
# Why internal/datacoord/snapshot_manager.go holds this value

On the Ostrava deployment (etcd across three zones ~40 ms apart) releasing a large snapshot's pins takes 6-9 s, so a 5 s timeout leaked the pins until restart.
